text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I ran into Narita Taishin in the main plaza, but—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ministerrr!
Wait for me, Minissssteeerrrr!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Ticket.
Stop crying first before you go chasing after them.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Becauuuse, becauuuse
Taishin is like this all because of meee~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Taishin's Trainer, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You've probably been seeing more buzz
about the three of us online lately, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Among the messages on the bulletin board Ticket showed me,
there was slander directed at Taishin mixed in."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was praising me so much,
I had no idea that kind of thing was written—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhh!!
I'm so sorry, Taishiiiiin!!
choice_data_list: Then why was I ignored earlier...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They probably just didn't know what to say.
...After all, there was slander directed at you as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It must be because their Trainer pushed them too hard
that they've fallen into a slump."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "...Believing that 'another Trainer could bring out Taishin's potential much better.'"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I know this might be meddlesome, but...
would you look out for Taishin for me?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I am sure that right now...
she needs to hear your words too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: I heard about the message board.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ticket and Hayahide?
...Hah, those busybodies.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'm letting it get to me.
I won't rush in recklessly like before.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So... you should just forget about it already.
Words like that, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm frustrated...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind, though.
I won't do anything reckless just 'cause I'm pissed off.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I really want to do some voluntary training, but... I'll hold back.
choice_data_list: Shall we get some good rest instead, then?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I really want to do some voluntary training, but... I'll hold back.
choice_data_list: Shall we get some good rest instead, then?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training with a heavy heart
won't produce any good results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I decided to make today's training a rest day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What's this?
choice_data_list: Hot cocoa. It really helps me calm down.
Hot cocoa. It helps me relax.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, thanks for that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward—I spent some relaxing, quiet time
with Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A moderate amount of independent training
will lead to Narita Taishin's growth."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I told her that bottling it up and stressing out is far worse for your health—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep it moderate...
and see how I feel as I go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The result—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed this independent training session
helped her with her self-analysis.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Were you even listening to me?
choice_data_list: Don't worry, I'm watching over you!
I'm watching over you, so you'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Well,
I think she'll be totally fine if that's the case.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After training concluded—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Phew...
choice_data_list: You seem to be in good shape.
You seem to be in good shape, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Mm.
Running really does clear my head.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching Narita Taishin run so effortlessly and freely made my own spirits brighten up as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Not really.
I'm going for one more lap.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(...Running makes me feel refreshed, but
I'm sure it's different for her.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I mean, even though it was my fault
that stuff was written about them,
why didn't they blame me at all...?!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Argh, dammit...!
I can't focus at all!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, Narita Taishin continued to harbor unresolved feelings, unable to vent her stress effectively.
